description: The first mod in my Silly Little Additions (SLA) series, I will be adding pellet versions of different fuel types, to allow you to smelt individual items with them. This mod series is my attempt at getting back into Minecraft modding after 6 months of not having worked on Very Berry.

mods.name: SLA - Fuel Pellets
mods.description: This mod adds pellet versions of different fuel sources, inspired by the various mods that add Tiny Coal. This is the first mod in my Silly Little Additions series(SLA).
